$comment: Single source of truth for the integration tests in test/integration/. The bump script (script/test/refresh-integration-snapshot.sh) regenerates everything below. Adding or removing a test account is a JSON edit only — see docs/howto/refresh-integration-test-blocks.md.
$tolerance_comment: Max relative drift allowed between forge-computed NAV and Debank's USD total at bump time. 0.01 = 1%.
$supportedDeBankProtocols_comment: Debank protocol id allowlist per chain. The bump script filters /v1/user/all_complex_protocol_list by (chain matches debankChainId) AND (id with chain prefix stripped ∈ list). Stored as the short id (no chain prefix) — Debank uses bare ids on mainnet and `<chain>_<id>` elsewhere; the script normalises both. Add a new entry whenever a balance adapter is added for a protocol Debank covers; if Debank doesn't cover the protocol, add nothing and accept that NAV will exceed filtered-Debank by that position's value.

1.name: mainnet
1.$untracked_by_design: Protocols and wallet/reward tokens deliberately excluded from this chain's allowlist (filtered-Debank ignores them; NAV doesn't track them). Re-evaluate when an adapter/feed becomes available. PROTOCOLS — full exclusion from the supportedDeBankProtocols allowlist: balancer2 (no Bal V2 adapter; LP positions remain dust on covered accounts); sablier (no adapter; lockups today only hold unpriceable tokens like COW); acrocc_v2 (Across V2 LP — not a karpatkey protocol of interest); multichain (defunct/exploited bridge); compound (Compound V2 — only V3 covered); layer3, espresso, ekubo (small ACCOUNT_12 reward bags in non-Karpatkey protocols). PARTIAL PROTOCOL COVERAGE — protocol IS in the allowlist but only some pools/markets are wired: convex (RLUSD/crvUSD/weETH/CRV pools are wired; the cvxFXS pool ACCOUNT_12 holds is not); stakewise (V3 OsToken + Genesis Vault + MetaVault are wired; legacy V2 Rewards and Staked contracts surfaced by Debank — obsolete, no new deposits — are not); uniswap3 (most observed pools are wired or disabled, but the WETH/COW pool is intentionally disabled because COW is unpriceable); spark (lending via the Aave-fork adapter is wired; the Spark Savings USDC vault is not, so a savings balance shows as drift — e.g. ACCOUNT_11); aave3 (Aave V3 lending is wired via the DataProvider query, but Aave stata-token wrap holdings — e.g. the Lido-instance aEthLidoGHO wrap ACCOUNT_11 holds, ~$233 — are invisible to getUserReserveData and have no balance adapter, so they show as drift); aave2 (Aave V2 lending — protocol deprecated and removed from NAV; aave2 stays in the allowlist only because DeBank files stkAAVE / Safety Module under it, so a residual Aave V2 lending/collateral balance shows as drift — e.g. ACCOUNT_11); kelpdao (rsETH held in wallet or as Aave collateral is priced, and Kelp withdrawal-queue / locked positions are now valued via the wired KelpWithdrawalQueue adapter — e.g. ACCOUNT_2's ~$282K lock). WALLET / REWARD TOKENS without a Chainlink mainnet price feed: COW, HEX, POL (Polygon-only feed), CASHW (spam), AEVO, GEAR (Gearbox token; appears as a Merkl reward), MORPHO (Base-only feed; appears as Merkl reward and as a Balancer V3 LP component), sETH2 (StakeWise V2 legacy LST; appears in Uni V3 ETH/sETH2 LPs), EKUBO. COW-containing UniV3/PancakeSwap pools are disabled in script/config/contracts-deployment-config/balance-adapters/<chainId>.json since their COW leg can't be valued — mainnet UniswapV3_WETH_COW_3000, Base PancakeSwapV3_WETH_COW, BSC PancakeSwapV2_ETH_COW, all enabled=false and each carrying its own $comment. NOTE the path: script/config/chains/<chainId>.json holds chain metadata and role addresses ONLY and has no balanceAdapters key — adapter config moved to contracts-deployment-config/ in the #70 config split, so the old 'chains/1.json.balanceAdapters' pointer led to an object that does not exist. COW SPECIFICALLY IS PERMANENT, unlike the rest of this list: no COW price feed exists on any chain and none is planned, so the 'Re-evaluate when an adapter/feed becomes available' instruction above does NOT apply to it and it needs no periodic re-checking. Mainnet COW exposure is material — roughly $1.6M across the Sablier lockups, two wallet balances and the UniV3 pool's COW leg — so the omission is large, but it is declared: because no COW-bearing adapter is enabled, NAV reports no COW position at all and DeBank's COW value lands in this report's 'Untracked by design' section rather than as unexplained drift.

8453.name: base
8453.$untracked_by_design: WALLET / REWARD TOKENS with no price feed: COW. PERMANENT — no COW price feed exists on any chain and none is planned, so this needs no periodic re-evaluation. The Base PancakeSwap V3 WETH/COW pool (PancakeSwapV3_WETH_COW in script/config/contracts-deployment-config/balance-adapters/8453.json) is enabled=false for the same reason: if enabled, NAVCalculator's per-asset registry filter would drop the COW leg and value the LP on its WETH side only, understating it by roughly half — worse than not reporting it. Because no COW-bearing adapter is enabled, NAV reports no COW position on Base and DeBank's COW value lands in this report's 'Untracked by design' section rather than as unexplained drift. Declared here so the classification does not depend on that adapter's enabled flag: if someone ever enables it, this entry still explains why the value is excluded. This key is documentation only — no code reads it (the report emits it as a human pointer). Scope note: it lists ONLY what has been audited for this chain, so absence of an entry is not evidence of full coverage.

accounts.$comment: Minimal multi-protocol 'adapter exercise' account (~$180). Holds ~$5–40 dust positions across Morpho/Aave V3/Cap/Sky/Ethena to exercise many adapters at once. Expected tolerance drift ~12% but only ~$22 absolute: dust-scale NAV-vs-DeBank pairing noise across the many tiny positions (Morpho vault grouping differs between the two; small Sky Savings / Ethena legs DeBank reports resolve under wallet/other NAV rows). Not a NAV error — magnified by the tiny base.

accounts.$comment: Originally added to exercise the UniswapV3 balance adapter on a clean, minimal account. IT NO LONGER DOES: measured 2026-07-30 at mainnet block 25622526, all FOUR NonfungiblePositionManager NFTs this account holds (#1204560, #1231724, #1258127, #1276763 — USDC/WETH 500bp and WETH/USDT 3000bp) have liquidity == 0 and tokensOwed == 0, so they contribute nothing and the Uniswap V3 adapter is not exercised at all. Repointing this fixture at a live UniswapV3 LP is a fixture decision, deliberately not taken here. Expected tolerance drift ~20% but immaterial in dollars (~$9 on a ~$40 dust account), and the cause is NOT Uniswap: NAV reports only four wallet legs (ETH/WETH/USDC/USDT) while filtered-DeBank adds the Convex cvxFXS position (~$8.66) — `convex` is in supportedDeBankProtocols but the cvxFXS rewarder is absent from ConvexCurveLPStakingMeta's governed instance set. An earlier revision of this comment blamed an unpriceable WETH/COW pool leg; that belongs to ACCOUNT_9_MAINNET_DIVERSIFIED, not here — this account holds no WETH/COW position. See chains.1.$untracked_by_design, which has it right.
